title: File:Rang Ghar, Sivsagar, Assam.jpg
author: Anurag2174
description: The rang Ghar is a two-storied building which once served as the royal sports-pavilion where Ahom kings and nobles were spectators at games like buffalo fights and other sports at Rupahi Pathar (pathar meaning "field" in Assamese) - particularly during the Rongali Bihu festival in the Ahom capital of Rangpur.
period_note: Surviving masonry predominantly 18th century; not direct evidence for a 15th-century palace
classification_note: Classified from source title/category; not a full visual authentication.
